verdict.rationale: Better Stack mentions a 'flexible data export' for team performance reports (docs-56). It also documents a global API token for managing anything via the API (docs-15, docs-45) and an MCP server that pipes telemetry into external LLM workflows (docs-41), which together suggest programmatic access to data. Nothing documents a full export of all data (logs, metrics, incidents, configs) in named open formats, and no OpenAPI spec was found (probe-3). missing for 10: documented full-account export, named open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/OTLP), bulk telemetry export, offboarding/portability guidance, independent corroboration.
